proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.maxSize
proposed_widenings.justification: Light targets 'one Large or smaller object' — a size cap on the valid target objects. ObjectFilter has no size field, so the encoded spell silently widens to objects of any size.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_recasts_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: Light ends early when the caster casts it again. No existing DurationEndTrigger variant matches this. The v4 lifecycle atom replace_on_recast exists but has no surface hook on Duration.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if you cast it again.

notes: Core mechanic (emit_light on an object for 1 hour) encodes cleanly as activation + direct + object attachment. Two secondary constraints are unrepresentable: (1) the Large-or-smaller size cap on the object target and (2) the 'cast again ends it' early-end trigger. The encoding is honest — the omitted constraints are surfaced as explicit widenings rather than faked with wrong atoms.
